text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Phew... Dammit, my body feels so heavy—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —...Phew... Alright!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best in the next race too!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm home~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's true, but... mm~... It's not just 
about that, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Spe-chan felt like she had already 
learned everything she could from me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I bet you're already looking forward to 
your next race— your showdown with 
Grass-chan."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone is so talented, yet they work 
even harder. The more they race, the 
stronger they become.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Then I...—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...No, it's nothing. I mean, I already 
knew this would happen."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I was different right from the start. I 
never had any of it to begin with. That's 
why—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I used my head to overcome it. 
...Yeah, I knew that all along, didn't I?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. About what's next... I want 
to run in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen. Held in the Kansai 
region, it serves as the grand finale of 
the spring season.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Apparently both Spe-chan and Grass-chan 
are running. ...There's something I want 
to confirm there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This race wasn't in our planned 
rotation... but seeing the serious look in 
Seiun Sky's eyes, there was only one 
answer to give.
choice_data_list: Let's run in it—the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's right, all I have to do is turn the 
tables again. I can do it. If I can't... 
then—
